items.source: Native or raw execution of the given Redis command along with the given arguments.
items.translation: 给定 Redis 命令及其参数的原生或原始执行。

items.source:
The command is executed as is, with as little interpretation as possible - it is up to the caller to take care of
any processing of arguments or the result.
items.translation: 该命令按原样执行，尽可能减少解释——调用者负责处理任何参数或结果的转换。

items.source: Interface defining the commands supported by Redis.
items.translation: 定义 Redis 支持的命令的接口。

items.source: command - Redis command to execute; must not be null.
items.translation: command - 要执行的 Redis command；不能为 null。

items.source: args - optional array of command arguments; may be empty;
items.translation: args - 可选的命令参数数组；可为空；

items.source: Costin Leau, Christoph Strobl, Mark Paluch
the execution result; may be null.
